about: As he ascends the altar steps, the priest asks God to take away iniquity so that he may enter the “Sancta sanctórum”, the holy of holies. He then kisses the altar and asks that his sins be forgiven through the merits of the saints whose relics are in this place, and of all the saints.

s01.narrative: The priest spreads and rejoins his hands, then says one word aloud.

narrative_citations.title: Missale Romanum (1962)
narrative_citations.locator: Ordo Missae, rubric at Oremus before Aufer a nobis

s03.narrative: The priest ascends the steps to the altar and continues silently.

narrative_citations.title: Missale Romanum (1962)
narrative_citations.locator: Ordo Missae, rubric for ascending the altar

s04.translation: Take away from us our iniquities, we beseech Thee, O Lord, that we may be worthy to enter the holy of holies with pure minds.

s06.narrative: With joined hands resting on the altar the priest bows over it and begins the second prayer.

narrative_citations.title: Missale Romanum (1962)
narrative_citations.locator: Ordo Missae, rubric before Oramus te, Domine

s07.translation: We beseech Thee, O Lord, by the merits of Thy Saints,

s08.narrative: The priest kisses the middle of the altar.

narrative_citations.title: Missale Romanum (1962)
narrative_citations.locator: Ordo Missae, rubric at quorum reliquiae hic sunt

s09.translation: whose relics are here, and of all the Saints: that Thou wouldst deign to forgive me all my sins. Amen.

w002.function: Imperative of aufero, a compound of ab and fero.

w005.function: Parenthetic polite formula inserted between the verb and its object.

w009.function: Introduces a purpose clause with “mereámur” (w014) in the subjunctive.

w011.function: An adjective used as a noun in the neuter plural: holy things. With “sanctórum” (w012) it forms “the Holy of Holies”.

w012.function: Neuter genitive plural dependent on the substantivized “Sancta” (w011), forming the expression Holy of Holies.

w022.function: Present indicative, first person plural. Compare the subjunctive “Orémus” (w001).

w027.function: Substantivized adjective, genitive plural: of the Saints.

w029.function: Genitive plural relative pronoun referring to “Sanctórum” (w027).

w030.function: Nominative subject of the relative clause.

w036.function: Introduces a purpose clause with “dignéris” (w038) in the subjunctive.

w041.function: Possessive adjective, accusative neuter plural, agreeing with “peccáta” (w040). The possessor is singular.
